status: PROPOSED input for the v4.1.5 package's own proposals/owner-decision-requests.json; the compilation owner copies the request there. Not a request the owner records from this file.

requests.title: IF41-VIEW gains the presentation contracts Causa.Ui.Contracts (CF-09 A)
requests.question: Approve the change of IF41-VIEW to the folded contract at the pinned digest: the frozen v4.1.4 IF41-VIEW types unchanged, followed by the namespace Causa.Ui.Contracts (screen view models, capability boundaries Visible/Understood, validation rules from the catalog, UiIntent, UiBackend, the seven-state presentation mapping and Limen bindings)? Additive only: no existing IF41 type, case or field changes. Its implementing file src/Causa.App/Projections.fs becomes integration-owned (types only) and compiles before Connection.fs.
options: A: approve the change as pinned (additive; consumers ui, ui-2, ui-3 and integration)
B: decline; IF41-VIEW stays as in v4.1.4 and the UI contracts wait for a later package
requests.recommendation: A. It applies CF-09 A (APR-CFUI-OWNER-1) without a compiler change. Verified: v4.1.4 ContractCheck builds with the folded file (0 warnings), both negative controls still refuse (FS1093), and the real v4.1.4 bootstrap with Projections.fs holding the folded text builds.
requests.rationale: V41Package.fs:1774-1787 requires every contract difference to name an interface-change decision of the package's own requests; V41Package.fs:1790 refuses new contract files, hence the fold.
requests.impact: Every UI role compiles against IF41-VIEW from bootstrap. IF41-VIEW's versioning rule (any union or record change is breaking) then covers the UI contracts too.
